objective: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

description: The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements.  Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman.  We will need a warlock to study them.

Take a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade.  Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign.  Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.
You may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.
progress: My most humble greetings, <class>. How might I help my <race> brother today?
completion: Ah, and where did you get this? Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?
Well, let me take a closer look...
